import java.awt.geom.AffineTransform

// Create and configure an affine transformation matrix
val transform = new AffineTransform()
transform.scale(2.0, 1.0)
transform.translate(0.0, 3.0)

// Apply the transformation to the spatial generator builder before generating data
val generatedData = sc.generateSpatialData
  .affineTransform(transform)
  .uniform(1000)

// Force materialization and verify the generated dataset size
val count = generatedData.count()
assert(count == 1000, s"Expected exactly 1000 generated features, but got $count")

// Verify the transformation affected the spatial bounds (default uniform is [0,1]x[0,1])
val firstGeom = generatedData.first().getGeometry
val env = firstGeom.getEnvelopeInternal
assert(env.getMinX >= 0.0 && env.getMaxX <= 2.0, s"X coordinates should be scaled by 2.0, got bounds ${env.getMinX} to ${env.getMaxX}")
assert(env.getMinY >= 3.0 && env.getMaxY <= 4.0, s"Y coordinates should be translated by 3.0, got bounds ${env.getMinY} to ${env.getMaxY}")

println(s"__CHECK__ affineTransform count=$count, first_geom_bounds=(${env.getMinX}, ${env.getMinY}, ${env.getMaxX}, ${env.getMaxY})")

import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Envelope
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.cg.Reprojector

// Create a bounding box in EPSG:4326 (WGS84) with (minX, maxX, minY, maxY) corresponding to (minLon, maxLon, minLat, maxLat)
val sourceEnvelope = new Envelope(-124.0, -114.0, 32.0, 42.0)

// Reproject the envelope to EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator)
val targetEnvelope = Reprojector.reprojectEnvelope(sourceEnvelope, 4326, 3857)

val minX = targetEnvelope.getMinX
val maxX = targetEnvelope.getMaxX
val minY = targetEnvelope.getMinY
val maxY = targetEnvelope.getMaxY

// Verify the reprojection transformed the coordinates from degrees to meters correctly
assert(minX < -13000000.0 && minX > -14000000.0, s"Unexpected minX: $minX")
assert(maxX < -12000000.0 && maxX > -13000000.0, s"Unexpected maxX: $maxX")
assert(minY > 3000000.0 && minY < 4000000.0, s"Unexpected minY: $minY")
assert(maxY > 5000000.0 && maxY < 6000000.0, s"Unexpected maxY: $maxY")

println(s"__CHECK__ reprojectEnvelope [${minX}, ${maxX}, ${minY}, ${maxY}]")

    var count = 0
    for (i <- values.indices; if defined(i)) {

    if (count == 0) 0.0f else sum / count

import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.indexing.RSGrovePartitioner

val originalCount = featuresRDD.count()

// Partition the RDD using RSGrovePartitioner to optimize spatial queries and enable distributed joins
val partitionedRDD = featuresRDD.spatialPartition(classOf[RSGrovePartitioner])
val partitionedCount = partitionedRDD.count()

// Verify that the partitioning did not lose or duplicate any features
assert(originalCount == partitionedCount, s"Partitioning altered the feature count: expected $originalCount, got $partitionedCount")

// Verify that the partitioner was successfully attached to the RDD metadata
assert(partitionedRDD.partitioner.isDefined, "The resulting RDD must have a spatial partitioner defined")

val partitionerName = partitionedRDD.partitioner.get.getClass.getSimpleName
println(s"__CHECK__ spatialPartition count: $partitionedCount, partitioner: $partitionerName")

sumSideLength.code:
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast._

// Compute the spatial summary of the features RDD
val summary = featuresRDD.summary

// Retrieve the sum of side lengths per dimension
val sideLengths: Array[Double] = summary.sumSideLength

// Verify the result against the maximum possible sum of side lengths
val numGeoms = summary.numNonEmptyGeometries
val totalWidth = summary.getMaxCoord(0) - summary.getMinCoord(0)
val totalHeight = summary.getMaxCoord(1) - summary.getMinCoord(1)

assert(sideLengths.length >= 2, s"Expected at least 2 dimensions, got ${sideLengths.length}")
assert(sideLengths(0) <= numGeoms * totalWidth + 1e-6, 
  s"Sum of side lengths X (${sideLengths(0)}) exceeds max possible (${numGeoms * totalWidth})")
assert(sideLengths(1) <= numGeoms * totalHeight + 1e-6, 
  s"Sum of side lengths Y (${sideLengths(1)}) exceeds max possible (${numGeoms * totalHeight})")

// Compute average side length per dimension as recommended by the documentation
val avgX = if (numGeoms > 0) sideLengths(0) / numGeoms else 0.0
val avgY = if (numGeoms > 0) sideLengths(1) / numGeoms else 0.0

println(s"__CHECK__ sumSideLength [${sideLengths.mkString(", ")}] avgX=$avgX avgY=$avgY")
